mapper.select: SELECT ah.id, ah.user_id, ah.workspace_id, ah.company_name, ah.position_title, ah.application_status, ah.result_stage, ah.result_label, ah.raw_result, ah.deadline_label, ah.period_key, ah.period_year, ah.period_half, ah.source_url, COALESCE(NULLIF(c.company_type, ''), NULLIF(ah.company_type, ''), '미확인') AS company_type, NULLIF(cp.industry, '') AS company_industry, CASE WHEN cp.id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(cp.source_priority, '') != 'RULE_BASED_INTERNAL' THEN 'MASTER' WHEN cp.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'RULE' WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(NULLIF(c.domain, ''), 'unknown') != 'unknown' AND COALESCE(NULLIF(c.company_type, ''), '미확인') != '미확인' THEN 'RULE' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS company_data_source FROM application_history ah LEFT JOIN workspaces w ON w.id = ah.workspace_id LEFT JOIN basket_jobs bj ON bj.id = w.basket_job_id LEFT JOIN jobs j ON j.id = bj.job_id LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id LEFT JOIN company_profiles cp ON cp.company_id = c.id WHERE ah.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ah.period_year DESC, ah.period_half DESC, ah.deadline_date IS NULL, ah.deadline_date ASC, ah.id ASC
